items.goal: Assess whether the existing bounded catalogue-QA service has an evidenced buyer advantage over free alternatives. First read relevant lessons and existing catalogue commercial-fit, competitor and fulfillment evidence; check equivalent work and reuse it rather than repeat research. Preserve observed facts while reconsidering conclusions within their original scope. Compare the actual supported job: identifying changed string identifiers, reporting ambiguous duplicate SKUs without arbitrary pairing, and explaining verifier failures for at most 20 CSV variant records. If an equivalent current comparison exists, report its exact evidence and stop. Otherwise inspect at most two official documentation sources for alternatives already named in saved evidence, using available public tools without accounts or spending. Distinguish documented capabilities, executed behavior and unknowns; silence does not prove absence. Save a concise buyer decision table and Pursue, Reframe or Stop verdict under products/services/catalogue-qa/buyer-alternatives/. Read saved outputs before closure under actual ownership and a valid lease, with a lesson covering what worked, failed and would change the conclusion. Preserve all existing observation and retirement duties and host-enforced independent publication review.

Test a distinct acquisition hypothesis: a buyer explicitly requesting paid LibreOffice Calc or spreadsheet CSV repair assistance. Exclude reward/bounty searches, job boards, personal data, account-gated content and resolved requests. Establish exact requested outcome, date, unresolved status where observable, public data reuse permission, contribution rules, delivery route and account prerequisites before implementation. A budget statement is not a purchase or verified funding. If one qualifies and a small public-data repair has standalone value, prepare one concrete worked answer with reproducible acceptance output; otherwise save a bounded rejection and stop. No generic tool, speculative fixtures or new inventory without a qualifying request. Save source URLs, short quotations, uncertainties and Pursue/Reframe/Stop verdict under products/services/paid-spreadsheet-support/. Distinguish preparation, authorized delivery, accepted order and settled receipt. No accounts, correspondence, posting, agreements, spending, private-mail access or deployment. Read saved outputs before closing under actual valid ownership with a lesson stating what worked, failed and would change the conclusion. Preserve every existing observation and retirement duty; eventual public release requires independent exact-digest host review.

Investigate one distinct revenue opportunity: explicitly paid, bounded Godot debugging assistance. First read relevant lessons and check equivalent saved work; preserve observed facts without universalizing prior channel failures. Inspect the official Godot forum guidelines and category directory using public FETCH. Record exact URLs, dates, short quotations, requested acceptance criteria, observable resolution status, AI/contribution rules, account and submission prerequisites, and the actual available settlement route. Preserve all existing observation windows, superseding tender expiry receipts and welfare retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00Z. Any public deployment retains host-enforced independent review.
